explanation: Horses naturally pull wagons, not push them, creating a structural contradiction. Additionally, "opposite facing" implies conflicting geometry. Using humans establishes the pushing action safely, while horse-costumed humans bridge the identity gap before revealing the final anatomically impossible configuration of opposing horses exerting force.
prompts_list: Two men pushing a heavy wooden wagon along a dirt road
Two men in horse costumes pushing a heavy wooden wagon along a dirt road
Two horses facing opposite directions pushing a heavy wooden wagon from behind
